method: Actual game model vertices transformed through live matrixWorld after settled ground and actual W stair ascent; compare soles with controller support and project both onto the same camera. Blueprint uses actual buttons, checkboxes and canvas mouse events; debug API only reads state and coordinates.

results.test: Actual transformed player boot vertices at ground-soles
Actual transformed player boot vertices at landing-soles
Actual housing focus button, canvas stair selection and assembly checkbox
Actual canvas selection exposes staircase path elevations and authored waypoints
Actual canvas entrance selection identifies closed upper entrance at3.065m
Actual canvas pan and zoom/fit buttons remain functional

interpretation: No positive model-to-support gap was measured at ground or landing. Idle leg rotation causes at most 1.75 mm penetration in these settled captures. The image alone gave a misleading impression of hovering; the exact cause of that impression was not isolated. This does not validate per-tread player foot IK.
limitations: Functional verification, not a performance benchmark.
One settled ground and one actual-ascent landing pose were sampled.
Closed upper entrance is an exterior endpoint; no interior access is claimed.
